text:
Omar: hypothetical sunday night: full-on shoegaze/washed-out guitars to melt into the couch, or marathon a tidy procedural (Law & Order style) and feel productive? recs welcome. :crescent_moon:

June: shoegaze!! My go-tos: Slowdive 'Souvlaki', My Bloody Valentine 'Loveless' (obviously), and Chapterhouse. Perfect for dim lamps and tea.

Priya: procedural if you need background brain candy. rec: 'Broadchurch' (UK)  quiet and sad but gripping. also 'Mare of Easttown' for big performances.

Felix: fun combo: shoegaze low, procedural on subtitles. you get emotional reverb + plot. tried it, 10/10.

Noah: album rec for shoegaze-y ambient: Hammock 'Mysterium' and Pale Saints. For something newer, check Beach House 'Depression Cherry'.

Omar: any short books that pair well with fuzzy guitars? looking for something under 300p, not too plot heavy.

June: try 'The Vegetarian' (Han Kang) for weirdly immersive mood, or 'Engine Summer' by John Crowley if you want hazy prose.

Priya: procedural vibe book: 'The Dry' (Jane Harper)  lean mystery, good pacing.

ChillBot: Quick poll created  option A: Shoegaze album night, option B: Procedural binge. Results (after 10m): A 4, B 2.

Felix: bonus soundtrack rec: the 'Twin Peaks' score (Angelo Badalamenti) sits between both worlds  moody and narrative.

Noah: also 'Blue Weekend' by Wolf Alice has some shoegaze-leaning tracks if you want modern indie.

Omar: nice list, thanks. will spin Slowdive + maybe sample Broadchurch ep 1. low stakes evening secured. :headphones:
